title: GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Convertible (19467) side door glass adjustment, 17 steps: fit the windshield-side weatherstrip and retainer, set the door glass with its guide cams, idler cams, anti-rattle cushions and up/down stops, then after the body is on the frame fit the convertible top, set glass height and fore/aft, align the rear edge to the rear weatherstrip and adjust the top side-rail weatherstrips. Sections are on the next sheet (K15).

fastening.to: birdcage (windshield pillar), through the w/shield side w/strip retainer
fastening.note: Screws "A" hold the w/shield side w/strip retainer. Step 1: install retainer with the lower two screws loosely engaged. Step 8: drill the attaching hole in the birdcage through the clearance hole in the w/strip, then tighten the three screws "A" to the specified torque.

Bolts "B" are the guide cam upper attaching bolts: two on the front guide cam (step 6a, after setting front-edge engagement and parallel condition, Section A-A) and two on the rear guide cam (step 16b, after setting the rear edge to the rear w/strip, Section D-D).
Two idler cam attaching bolts "C" (step 6b). Step 12: loosen them to correct the angle (parallel condition of the glass front edge to the w/shield) after body drop, then retorque.

Bolt "D" locks each anti-rattle cushion. Step 7: push front anti-rattle cushion outboard until it firmly contacts the glass, tighten bolt "D". Step 16c: rear anti-rattle cushion bolt "D" after pushing the rear cushion outboard against the glass.
Two screws "E" hold the front and rear upper stops; set in contact with the window rollers, then tighten (step 14). Controls glass full-up height.
Three screws "F" set the glass fore and aft relationship (step 13).
Rear guide cam lower attaching bolt "G" (step 16a); rear guide cam is adjusted at the belt line to bring the rear edge of the glass into contact with the rear w/strip (Section D-D).
Two screws "H" hold the lower stop: roll glass down until the upper edge is flush with the door outer panel, set the lower stop to the roller and tighten (step 15).

Side rail w/strip attaching screws: left loosely engaged when fitting the top (step 10); the convertible top side upper w/strip assemblies are adjusted inboard/outboard for seal interference (Section C-C) and the w/strip attaching bolts tightened to the specified torque (step 17).
Rear w/strip attaching screws tightened in step 16d after adjusting the rear w/strip and glass simultaneously to a parallel condition (Section D-D).

notes: ON TRIM LINE BEFORE BODY DROP
1. I[nsta]ll w/shield side w/strip retainer with lower two screws "[?]" loosely engaged.

2. Cement the w/shield side w/strip in the retainer lining the top trim line of the w/strip flush with the upper outer corner of the header molding. (Do not apply cement to back of w/strip above retainer).
3. Install side door glass and all related parts with the attaching bolts to the door inner panel loosely engaged.
4. Roll the glass up until the front corner is approximately .50 inch below the front upper corner of the corner header molding.
5. Push the glass forward until it si slightly engaged in the groove in the w/shield si[de] w/strip retainer.

6. Push the glass and w/strip [r]etainer outboard at the belt line until the nylon stabilizer button on the glass contacts the wedge surface on the door inner panel. Set front edge of glass relationship to w/strip for proper engagement and parallel condition. See Section A-A. Tighten the following screws to the specified torque. a. Two front guide cam upper attaching bolts "B". b. Two idler cam attaching bolts "C".
7. Push front anti-rattle cushion outboard until it firmly contacts the glass and tighten bolt "D" to the specified torque.

8. Lower the glass to provide access to the w/shield side w/strip retainer attaching screws. Apply cement to the upper surface of the w/strip and position it to the body with the upper end of the w/strip being flush with the upper corner of the header molding. Drill the attaching hole in the birdcage through the clearance hole provided in the w/strip. Tighten the three screws "A" to the specified torque.
9. Check door fit to body and door lock to striker relatio[nshi]p and correct as required for any misalignment derived from body mounting to frame.

10. Install convertible top and adjustment to fit body. Set top front header relationship to w/shield header as shown in Sections B-B, C-C and E-E. Leave side rail w/strip attaching screws loosely engaged.

11. Roll side door glass up to .06 minimum swing clearance to the outer lip on the side w/strip. Move glass forward or rearward as required by final height determination to obtain proper interference fit to the w/shield side w/strip. (See Section A-A)

12. Check the parallel condition of the front edge of glass to the w/shield to determine if any misalignment has resulted from mounting the body to the frame. Correct as required by loosening the two bolts "C", correcting the angle, and retorquing the bolts. If this step is required it is necessary to simultaneously control the relationship given in step no. 11.
13. Tighten the three screws "F"; to set the fore and aft relationship, to the specified torque.
14. Set fron and rear upper stops in contact with the window rollers and tighten the two screws "E" to the specified torque.
15. Roll glass down until the upper edge is flush with the door outer panel, set the lower stop to the roller and tighten two screws "H" to the specified torque.

16. Adjust the rear guide cam at the belt line to brin the rear edge of glass into contact with the rear w/strip as shown in Section D-D. Adjust w/strip and glass simultaneously to obtain parallel condition. Push rear anti-rattle cushion outboard until it firmly contacts the glass. Tighten the following screws to the specified torque. a. Rear guide cam lower attaching bolt "G". b. Two rear guide cam upper attaching bolts "B". c. Rear anti-rattle cushion bolt "D". d. Rear w/strip attaching screws.

17. Adjust convertible top side upper w/strip assemblies inboard and outboard as required to obtain seal interference as shown in Section C-C. Tighten w/strip attaching bolts to the specified torque. See Sheet K11.
